svg.title: Kernelridge attestation
svg.desc: A vault with a turning combination dial and a SHA-256 digest plate; a report is posted into its slot. The report is canonicalised and hashed, signed with Ed25519 through the system openssl, saved to a local SQLite store, and reported as unsigned when openssl is missing.

g.text: local SQLite history, keyed by digest
signed: false, with an explicit note
